verse.verse_1: Did you see him who gives the lie to the Reward and Punishment of the Hereafter?
verse.verse_2: Such is the one who repulses the orphans away,
verse.verse_3: and urges not the feeding of the needy.
verse.verse_4: Woe, then, to those who pray,
verse.verse_5: but are heedless in their Prayers,
verse.verse_6: those who do good (in order) to be seen,
verse.verse_7: and deny people the articles of common necessity.
